title: Mindset in a Crisis: There Is a Way
header_line: My analysis of one book on an entrepreneur's life. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What do you do when your own team says there is no way out?

groups.heading: He's out sailing, and he gets a call

lines.text: What happens when he runs into a massive obstacle, I asked? A student said: he tried to negotiate first, and then went the legal route.

The book's idea: the satellite company did not launch the second satellite, where his space was going to be. He was out sailing when he got the call. Even his own staff and lawyers said: we can't do this.
Think about his mindset in that moment, I said. He is on a plane going back in the middle of a crisis. Without the satellite space, the channel wouldn't exist, because he was burning cash.

groups.heading: He backs it up with a mindset

lines.text: They find a clause in the contract, I said, a very tense situation: if you sue us, you will be first in line to get the space. So he sues them, and he gets the space.
It goes to show that even in an extremely stressful situation, he backs it up with a mindset, I said. There is a possibility to get this done. That is a message in itself.
What is the clause in your own contract or situation that gives you a way through?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write a time a team member or adviser told you it couldn't be done.
Write what you did in that moment.
Write the clause, option or door that you may have missed.
Write what 'there is a possibility' would look like in that situation.
Write your first call or step in the next crisis.

check.q: What did the student say the author did first about the satellite problem?
choices: Tried to negotiate, then went the legal route

check.q: What did I say would have happened without the satellite space?
What did I say the author backs a stressful situation up with?
choices: A mindset that there is a possibility

recap: In a crisis, back it up with the mindset that there is a way.
